_doc: start_noise: where each ray of the atmosphere pass starts its march (tools/assets/make_blue_noise.py); the pass averages no frames, so a start with a pattern of its own stays on the screen. rain_mist, rain_mist_height_m: the mist the rain alone lays, per unit of rain, and how high it stands; a modelling choice, the 4.0's rule, held to the ground of the rain pair. canyon_sky_most, canyon_sun_cut: the sky's share of a pixel's light, less the sun's share of the light on level ground times the cut; a modelling choice checked on walls and street floors against the 4.0 (ports/landscape/report.md). The drawn sky (render/sky_view.gd, render/weather_view.gd, render/thunder.gd, shaders atmosphere, rain, lightning). rain_fall_ms 8.8: terminal velocity of a large raindrop (Gunn & Kinzer 1949, J. Meteor. 6(4); the paper's table was not read, about 10 m/s for the largest drops by a secondary summary). sound_ms 343: sound in air at 20 C. stroke_s 0.06: the interval between strokes (geometric mean 57 ms over 199 intervals; Rakov & Uman 2003: 3-5 strokes a flash, tens of ms apart). strike_life_s 0.45: longer than the 175 ms mean flash measured in Austria, a modelling choice so the player sees it. bolt_core, the channel's light, brighter than white; rain_colour and rain_fade, the drops' colour (sRGB) and how the box and a streak's tip fade (render/shaders/rain.gdshader), modelling choices. bolt_kick, midpoint displacement of the channel: modelling choice compared with reference-minha. puffs: across, up, along, radius of the seven puffs in units of the cloud's size, modelling choice. shadow_night_cut: a cloud's shadow takes the sun's direct share of the light on lit ground (render/daylight.gd direct_share, live: less in rain and at dusk), less this share of the night, the Roadcraft lab's (postprocess.ts shadowStrength). strike_reach: a bolt falls evenly over the disc of this share of the view's width round its middle; bolt_height_least_m, bolt_height_more_m: it comes from this high plus up to this more, leaning either way by up to half of bolt_lean_share of that height (the lab's renderer.ts strikeAt). thunder_silent, thunder_least_peak, thunder_rise_*, thunder_length_*, thunder_rolls, thunder_fade: a clap's envelope, the lab's (ui/thunder.ts): it rises from silent to its peak in rise_s plus rise_far_s as far off; each roll [from s, a random span added s, share of the peak, time constant s] heads for its gain from the gain it found; the fade [from s, a random span s, time constant as a share of the clap's length] heads for silent; the clap lasts length_s plus length_far_s as far off. Modelling choices of the lab by ear. mist_beta, fog_extinction, noise_*, rain_box_*, rain_opacity*, thunder_*, sun_gain, overcast_*: modelling choices compared with the 4.0 as the player sees it.

contact_shader._doc: The sun's contact shadows (render/shaders/contact.gdshader, render/contact_pass.gd), by eye as the 4.0's canyonLight.

atmosphere._doc: The look of the atmosphere pass (render/shaders/atmosphere.gdshader, fog_bank.gdshaderinc, cloud_field.gdshaderinc), set by render/sky_view.gd as uniforms of these names; by eye as the 4.0's air, its parts said at each uniform. Colours are linear light, lengths metres, shares of a cloud's size where said. puff_flat, puff_blend, cloud_base_edge, cloud_boil, cloud_noise, cloud_shape_k and cloud_erode shape a cloud (Schneider 2015); its shadow takes both noises at their mean.
